problem.title: Find Servers That Handled Most Number of Requests
problem.summary: You have `k` servers numbered from `0` to `k-1` that are being used to handle multiple requests simultaneously. Each server has infinite computational capacity but cannot handle more than one request at a time. The requests are assigned to servers according to a specific algorithm:

solution.approach: Analyzed problem constraints and identified optimal greedy/heap simulation strategy.
solution.verification_notes:
